---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "feature: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you're hitting. **Lead with the problem, not the proposed solution** — we may know a simpler fix you haven't considered.

## What would you like to happen?

The behavior or capability you'd want.

## Why is this important?

Who benefits, and how often does this come up in your work?

## What have you tried?

Workarounds you've used, or alternatives you've considered.

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, related issues, similar features in other tools, etc.

---

> Larger features (new grounding domains, new languages, architectural
> changes) are best discussed in [Discussions](https://github.com/HthSolid/claude-dejavu/discussions)
> first — gives us a chance to align on approach before code is written.
